concept.concept: An illustration of a person buried in a pile of autumn leaves reading a book, surrounded by the text 'Currently Unavailable — Please Leave A Book Recommendation'.
concept.audience: Avid readers who love autumn and carry books and library hauls in tote bags
concept.rationale: Totes are the canonical accessory for book lovers. Combining fall aesthetics with bookish humor in a seasonal tote is timely and functional. Strong gift purchase potential ahead of the holiday season.

design.image_prompt: The design prominently features the text "Currently Unavailable — Please Leave A Book Recommendation" — spelled exactly, large and readable, integrated into the composition, no other words anywhere. Flat vector illustration of a person sitting cross-legged, partially buried in a large pile of autumn leaves in warm oranges, deep reds, and golden yellows, reading an open book held in their hands. The figure is simplified with bold geometric shapes—clean lines for the body, solid color blocks for clothing in warm earth tones. Autumn leaves in 4-5 distinct colors cascade around them in overlapping layers. Centered composition with generous white margins on all sides. Solid warm cream background. Single-color, high-contrast screen-print aesthetic with no gradients, no shading, no photorealism. Readable at 12×16 inches from across a room.

design.style: Bold sans-serif, all caps, arranged in two curved lines arching around the top and bottom of the illustration in a deep charcoal or forest green color, integrated into the composition without overwhelming the central figure.
